request:
镜头 s23：纪录片空镜，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary establishing shot on a long zoom lens, atmospheric haze
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，固定机位，从空无一人的集结平台望向黑水。水面下有一盏头灯的微光，慢慢往深处沉，越来越暗，最后熄灭；探照灯还亮着，平台上没有人。环境声：水泵声停了，只剩轻轻的水声，然后几乎没有声音。
情绪：silent, grieving, final
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot, locked-off archival camera
景深与虚实：Archival softness, the floodlights blooming, the water surface glossy and dark.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival frame from the deserted floodlit staging platform at the edge of the flooded hall: equipment cases and empty diving helmets on the wet tarp, two floodlights on tripods, and out in the black water a single helmet lamp glowing faintly beneath the surface. No person is visible. Blocking lock: the empty platform with cases and helmets fills the lower foreground, the floodlights stand at frame left and right, the black water fills the centre where the faint underwater glow sits.
Picture 2: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：gentle lapping water, a pump winding down, then near silence
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot, locked-off archival camera on a long zoom lens, held from wide shot to wide shot with no movement, atmospheric haze across the flooded hall; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. At the start the empty platform fills the lower foreground with equipment cases and empty diving helmets on the wet tarp, the two floodlights stand at frame left and frame right, and the black water fills frame centre with a faint glow just below the middle of the frame; no person anywhere in the shot. Start: the water is still, its surface glossy and dark, the small helmet-lamp glow hanging steady under the surface at frame centre, the floodlights bloating into hot white balls above it. Middle: the glow begins to drift away from the camera and downward, its halo softening and shrinking through the murky water, the last bubbles breaking the surface and spreading into rings that widen across frame centre and fade against the platform edge. End: the glow dims to a thin dull point, sinks out of sight, and goes out; the black water stays empty and glossy, the floodlights keep burning over the deserted platform, the wet tarp and the helmets exactly as they were, nothing else moves. Mood: silent, grieving, final. Blur: archival softness overall, the floodlights blooming into halos with faint horizontal smear on the tape, the water surface sharp and glossy in the near centre, the concrete pillars and the far end of the hall dissolving into haze. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Gentle lapping of water against the platform edge, a pump motor winding down and cutting out, water dripping from a diving helmet onto the wet tarp, the low electrical hum of the floodlight stands, the softest echo of a large flooded concrete hall, then near silence; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
